systemStatus.title: System status
systemStatus.description: Checks that the Smart Home Security Check service is reachable.

login.title: Sign in
login.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

register.title: Create an account
register.done: If the address is valid you will receive an e-mail with a link to activate the account (valid 24 hours).
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

verify.title: Confirm e-mail
verify.done: Address confirmed. You can now sign in.
verify.resent: If the account is waiting for confirmation you will receive a new e-mail.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter the e-mail of your account: we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If the address is registered you will receive an e-mail with the link (valid 30 minutes).

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Password updated. All open sessions were closed: sign in with the new password.

invitation.title: Activate your account
invitation.description: You have been invited to use Smart Home Security Check. Choose the password of your account.
invitation.done: Account activated. You can now sign in with your e-mail and the password you chose.

password.hint: At least {{min}} characters. A long sentence beats a complicated word.

password.PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: This password is among the most used ones: choose another.
password.PASSWORD_TOO_SIMPLE: The password is too simple (repeated or sequential characters).
password.PASSWORD_CONTAINS_PERSONAL_DATA: The password must not contain your name or e-mail.

password.title: Change password
password.done: Password changed. Other sessions were closed.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices and browsers you are signed in with.

homes.title: Homes
homes.empty: No homes yet. Create one to connect the local agent.
homes.emptyNoCreate: No homes are available to your account.
homes.archiveConfirm: The home will be archived and no longer visible. Confirm?

networks.title: Networks
networks.description: Declare the local networks of this home. Only private ranges are accepted (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24). Declaring or authorizing a network never starts a scan.
networks.name: Name
networks.cidrHint: Only private IPv4 networks (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x, /22 or smaller) or local IPv6 (fc00::/7, fe80::/10, prefix /64 or smaller).

attestation.v1: I declare that I own the network {{cidr}} or that I have been authorized in writing by its owner to check its security, and I take responsibility for this statement.

networks.attestationNote: The statement is recorded with date, time and user. Checks will always be non-invasive and you can revoke the authorization at any time.

customers.title: Customers
customers.name: Name or company name
customers.notesHint: Do not enter passwords or other sensitive data.
customers.archiveConfirm: The customer will be archived. Confirm?

plan.title: {{plan}} plan
plan.note: Limits apply to new creations; disabled users and archived items are not counted.

users.title: Users
users.disableConfirm: The user will be signed out of every device immediately. Confirm?

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.description: The user will receive an e-mail with a link (valid 7 days) to choose their own password.
invite.resent: New invitation sent: the previous link no longer works.

agents.title: Local agents
agents.empty: No agent connected to this home.
agents.name: Name
agents.revokeConfirm: The agent will have to be enrolled again. Continue?

enroll.title: Connect an agent
enroll.description: Generate a one-time code and use it to register the agent installed on a computer of this network. The code expires after 30 minutes.
enroll.showOnce: Copy the code now: it will not be shown again. It expires at {{expires}}.
enroll.command: Save it to a file (e.g. token.txt) and run on the agent computer:
enroll.service: Then install it as a service (as administrator):

diagnosis.noRouter: None (configurable on the agent with 'shsc-agent router')
diagnosis.noHeartbeat: The agent has not sent its diagnostics yet. Start it as a service.

warning.ARP_TABLE_ONLY: The agent only reads the devices already known to the system: some devices may not be found.
warning.ARP_UNAVAILABLE: ARP discovery is not available: network coverage will be reduced.
warning.ICMP_UNAVAILABLE: Ping (ICMP) is not available: devices that only answer pings will not be found.
warning.NO_USABLE_INTERFACE: The agent computer has no active, usable network interface.

scans.title: Scans
scans.description: Start a scan of this home's authorized networks manually. The agent finds which devices are present (ARP, ping, mDNS, SSDP/UPnP, NetBIOS, reverse DNS, IPv6 and, if configured on the agent, the router integrations): no port scan, no credential is tried. Scans never start automatically.
scans.devicesNote: Addresses observed in use on the authorized networks: this is not a list of vulnerabilities. Addresses with the same MAC are grouped.
scans.name: Name
scans.selfDeclared: Declared by the device, not verified.
scans.portMappings: The router declares {{count}} port forwardings to the Internet (UPnP):

reason.AGENT_LOST: The agent stopped responding during the scan.

warning.TARGET_NOT_CONNECTED: An authorized network is not directly connected to the agent's computer: it was not scanned.
warning.IPV6_NOT_SUPPORTED: IPv6 networks are not scanned yet.
warning.HOST_LIMIT_REACHED: The maximum number of addresses per scan was reached: partial results.
warning.ARP_TABLE_ONLY: The agent may not send ARP requests: only devices already known to the system were read.
warning.ARP_UNAVAILABLE: ARP is not available on this operating system.
warning.INTERFACE_WITHOUT_ARP: The network interface does not support ARP.
warning.ARP_ERROR: Some ARP requests could not be sent.
warning.OUT_OF_SCOPE_RESULTS: Some results outside the authorized networks were discarded.
warning.LATE_UPLOAD: The results arrived after the agent had been considered unreachable.
warning.ICMP_UNAVAILABLE: Ping (ICMP) is not available: devices that only answer pings were not found.
warning.MDNS_UNAVAILABLE: mDNS is not available: the services announced by devices were not read.
warning.SSDP_UNAVAILABLE: SSDP/UPnP is not available: UPnP device descriptions were not read.
warning.NETBIOS_UNAVAILABLE: NetBIOS is not available: Windows computer names were not read.
warning.NDP_TABLE_ONLY: IPv6: only the neighbours already known to the system were read.
warning.NDP_UNAVAILABLE: IPv6: discovery is not available on this system.
warning.ROUTER_OUT_OF_SCOPE: The router address configured on the agent is not in the authorized networks: it was not contacted.
warning.ROUTER_AUTH_FAILED: The router refused the credentials configured on the agent: integration stopped without further attempts.
warning.ROUTER_UNREACHABLE: The router did not answer the integration configured on the agent.
warning.HA_OUT_OF_SCOPE: Home Assistant is not on an authorized network of the home: it was not contacted.
warning.HA_UNREACHABLE: Home Assistant did not answer (network, timeout or invalid HTTPS certificate).
warning.HA_AUTH_FAILED: Home Assistant refused the token: create a new long-lived token and configure the agent again.
warning.HA_INVALID_RESPONSE: Unexpected answer from Home Assistant: inventory not read.
warning.HA_PLAIN_HTTP: Home Assistant is reached over unencrypted HTTP: the token travels in clear text on the local network.
warning.HA_INVENTORY_TRUNCATED: Home Assistant has more than 500 devices: inventory truncated.
warning.PORT_SCAN_HOST_PAUSED: A device stopped answering during the port check: to avoid overloading it the check was paused, the results are partial.
warning.PORT_SCAN_OUT_OF_SCOPE: A device outside the authorized networks connected to the agent was not checked.
warning.PORT_SCAN_INCOMPLETE: The port check did not finish (scan cancelled or maximum duration reached): partial results.

profileHint.DISCOVERY: Finds the devices connected to the authorized networks, without checking their ports.
profileHint.QUICK: Finds the devices and checks about 40 TCP ports and 6 widespread UDP services. Read-only requests: no login, no password is ever tried.
profileHint.STANDARD: Finds the devices and checks about 300 TCP ports and 8 UDP services. Takes longer; read-only requests, no login, no password is ever tried.

scans.deleteWarning: Permanent deletion: devices and findings seen only by this scan are deleted too.
scans.clearHint: Deletes all scans, devices, findings, people, reports and alerts of the home. Home, networks and agent stay.
scans.clearWarning: Permanent operation without backup: it cannot be undone.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Inventory built from the scans. Type, manufacturer and operating system are estimates with a confidence level and the sources they come from: a single weak hint is never enough, in that case the device stays "unidentified". You can correct the category by hand: your choice is never overwritten.
devices.empty: No devices: start a scan to build the inventory.
devices.name: Name
devices.notInLastScan: not seen in the last scan
devices.randomizedNote: The device uses a random MAC address (privacy): it may change over time and the manufacturer cannot be derived from it.
devices.merge: Yes, it is the same device
devices.mergeWarning: If you confirm, the interfaces, address history and issues of this device move to "{{name}}" and this entry is removed. This cannot be undone.

addressesTable.title: IP addresses and history
addressesTable.note: Temporary (privacy) IPv6 addresses not seen for 30 days are removed from the history. Only addresses of authorized networks are recorded.

devices.suggestion: The latest scans point with good confidence to the category "{{category}}": your manual choice stays until you change it.

source.DEVICE: Icon provided by the device itself (UPnP), fetched automatically by the scan
source.USER: Photo uploaded by you: scans never replace it

photo.none: No image: the device does not expose one. You can upload a photo.
photo.hint: PNG or JPEG, at most 1 MB.
photo.invalid: Only PNG or JPEG photos up to 1 MB.

card.title: Device card
card.statusRule: Verified: declared by the device, confirmed by you or by two concordant independent sources. Probable: inferred or with conflicting sources. Unknown: no source.

integrations.plainHttp: Unencrypted HTTP: the Home Assistant token travels in clear text on the local network. Configure HTTPS.
integrations.truncated: Inventory truncated to the first 500 devices.
integrations.note: Data read from Home Assistant with the owner's token (read-only) and declared by its integrations: not verified by the scan. Zigbee, Z-Wave, Thread and Bluetooth devices have no IP address.

ports.title: Open ports and services
ports.none: No open port among those checked.
ports.notScanned: The ports of this device have not been checked yet: start a Quick or Standard scan.
ports.declaredNote: "Probable": service inferred from the port number. "Confirmed": the device answered the protocol. Product, version and titles are declared by the device and not verified.
ports.summary: ports checked: {{tcp}} TCP and {{udp}} UDP · open {{open}} · closed {{closed}} · no answer {{silent}}

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: The security status of your homes, riskiest first. The score is the one of the last Quick or Standard scan.
overview.noScore: No score: run a Quick or Standard scan.
overview.notComputed: The last scan (Discovery only) did not update the score.
overview.restricted: You are not allowed to see the security status of this home.

vulnerabilities.title: Known vulnerabilities (CVE)
vulnerabilities.description: The CVEs the security analysis matched to the devices of the home, actively exploited ones (KEV) first, then by CVSS score.
vulnerabilities.none: No known vulnerability matched to the devices.
vulnerabilities.limit: At most 500 CVEs of non-resolved findings are listed. The link opens the CVE page on the NVD website.

networkMap.title: Network map
networkMap.description: The devices of each authorized network around the router, colored by the points they take off the last score. Select a device for its details.
networkMap.noRisk: No score computed: risk colors are not available.

legend.high: many points taken off (15 or more)

networkMap.logicalNote: Logical map: the links show the network a device belongs to, not the real cabling or Wi-Fi, which cannot be observed from the local network.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: What changed in your homes: new serious issues, resolved issues, score drops, new devices, failed scans and unreachable agents. The same event repeated stays a single alert with the number of times.

text.AGENT_OFFLINE: Agent "{{name}}" unreachable for more than 15 minutes

preferences.title: Notification preferences
preferences.description: Choose which alerts you receive on the dashboard and by e-mail, and from which severity.
preferences.note: E-mails go to the address of your account. A repeated alert sends no more e-mails until it is resolved. You only receive the alerts of the homes you can see.

billing.title: Subscription
billing.trialOffer: {{days}}-day free trial: you are charged when the trial ends, cancel before then to pay nothing.
billing.disabled: Online subscriptions are not enabled on this installation.
billing.note: Payment happens on Stripe: card data never passes through this dashboard. The plan is updated as soon as Stripe confirms the payment. A downgrade deletes no data, but no new resources can be created beyond the limits.
billing.checkoutSuccess: Thank you! The plan will be updated as soon as Stripe confirms the payment (usually a few seconds).
billing.checkoutCancel: Payment cancelled: the plan has not changed.

limits.whiteLabel: White label (name, color and logo, also in PDF reports)

branding.title: White label
branding.unavailable: White label is included in the Pro plan.
branding.logoHint: PNG or JPEG, at most 256 KB and 2048×2048 pixels.

assistant.title: Security assistant
assistant.disclaimer: It answers only with the data of this home (score, issues, devices) and cites them. It performs no action and invents nothing: if the data is missing it says so. Questions and answers are not saved.
assistant.question: Your question
assistant.placeholder: For example: what should I fix first?

fallback.NOT_GROUNDED: the AI answer was not supported by the data: the standard answer is shown
fallback.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: AI service unavailable: the standard answer is shown

reports.title: PDF reports
reports.description: A PDF report, readable also by non-technical people, with score, coverage, issues to fix, devices found and limits of the analysis.
reports.noScans: No completed scan: run a scan to generate a report.

risk.title: Security score
risk.description: From 0 to 100 (100 = no known problem). The score depends on what the scans could check: that is why it is always shown with the coverage.
risk.noScan: No score yet: run a Quick or Standard scan.

notComputed.PORT_SCAN_REQUIRED: The last scan (Discovery only) does not check ports and services: no score was computed. Run a Quick scan or higher.

risk.showingLast: The last computed score is shown below.
risk.provisional: Provisional score: the scan checked little of the network, so the score is capped at {{cap}} (it would be {{uncapped}} otherwise). Finding no problem does not mean there is none.

delta.title: What changed
delta.none: No change in the counted findings.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: How much of the network the scan could check: analyzed devices, profile, discovery techniques that worked and router integration.
coverage.hint: Below 80% coverage the judgement cannot be "Excellent": a Standard scan and the router integration increase it.

why.title: Why this score?
why.formula: Each finding takes points off: severity × type × confidence × device importance × Internet exposure × active exploitation (KEV). A single device takes off at most 45 points.
why.capped: For at least one device the points taken off were capped at {{cap}}.
why.notScored: {{count}} items to check take no points off.

excluded.title: Excluded from the score (false positives and accepted risks)

findings.title: Security findings
findings.description: What the scans of the authorized networks found. A confirmed vulnerability is not a potential risk: each item tells how certain it is and which data it comes from.
findings.empty: No findings with the selected filters.
findings.cveNote: Matched to the product and version declared by the service, not verified. Descriptions from the NVD.

CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY.label: Confirmed vulnerability
CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY.explanation: The version was read from the protocol itself and exactly matches a known vulnerability.

POTENTIAL_RISK.label: Potential risk
POTENTIAL_RISK.explanation: The collected data points to a possible risk that could not be confirmed (declared version, version range or conditions to check).

SUSPICIOUS_CONFIGURATION.label: Suspicious configuration
SUSPICIOUS_CONFIGURATION.explanation: The device answered with a configuration considered unsafe.

UNVERIFIED_INFORMATION.label: Information to check
UNVERIFIED_INFORMATION.explanation: Useful information to check, not necessarily a problem.

triage.title: Manage
triage.note: A reason is required (except to reopen) and is recorded. "Resolved" is set only by a later scan.

telnet-open.title: Telnet enabled on port {{port}}
telnet-open.description: Telnet sends passwords and commands in clear text: anyone on the same network can read them. It is also a common target of IoT malware.
telnet-open.recommendation: Disable Telnet in the device settings and use SSH or the official app. If that is not possible, update the firmware or consider replacing the device.

ftp-cleartext.title: Unencrypted FTP on port {{port}}
ftp-cleartext.description: FTP sends credentials and files in clear text over the network.
ftp-cleartext.recommendation: Disable FTP or use SFTP / FTPS; turn the service off if it is not needed.

http-login-cleartext.title: Login page without HTTPS on port {{port}}
http-login-cleartext.description: Credentials typed in this page travel in clear text on the local network.
http-login-cleartext.recommendation: Enable HTTPS in the device settings if available and use a unique password.

tls-legacy-protocol.title: Outdated TLS protocols on port {{port}} ({{versions}})
tls-legacy-protocol.description: TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are deprecated and have known weaknesses.
tls-legacy-protocol.recommendation: Update the firmware or disable TLS 1.0/1.1 in the settings, keeping TLS 1.2 or 1.3.

tls-certificate-expired.title: Expired certificate on port {{port}}
tls-certificate-expired.description: The certificate presented by the device has expired: browsers show warnings and an attack becomes hard to notice.
tls-certificate-expired.recommendation: Renew or regenerate the certificate in the device settings or update the firmware.

smb-v1-enabled.title: SMB1 enabled on port {{port}}
smb-v1-enabled.description: SMB1 is an obsolete protocol exploited by well-known malware (e.g. ransomware).
smb-v1-enabled.recommendation: Disable SMB1 and use SMB2 or SMB3.

upnp-exposed-mapping.title: Port {{externalPort}} opened to the Internet via UPnP
upnp-exposed-mapping.description: The router declares an automatic forwarding (UPnP) that makes port {{internalPort}} of the device reachable from the Internet.
upnp-exposed-mapping.recommendation: Remove the forwarding from the router, disable UPnP if not needed and use the vendor's official remote access.

upnp-igd-enabled.title: UPnP enabled on the router
upnp-igd-enabled.description: Any device of the network can open ports to the Internet without asking.
upnp-igd-enabled.recommendation: Unless game consoles or apps need it, disable UPnP in the router settings.

tr069-exposed.title: TR-069 remote management port ({{port}}) reachable
tr069-exposed.description: TR-069 is used by the provider to manage the router remotely. It is usually normal, but worth knowing.
tr069-exposed.recommendation: Check with the provider that the router firmware is up to date.

rtsp-open.title: RTSP video stream on port {{port}}
rtsp-open.description: The device offers an RTSP video stream on the local network. Only a check (OPTIONS) was sent: no video was opened.
rtsp-open.recommendation: Make sure the stream requires a strong password; disable it if you do not use it.

mqtt-cleartext.title: Unencrypted MQTT on port {{port}}
mqtt-cleartext.description: MQTT messages and any credentials travel in clear text.
mqtt-cleartext.recommendation: Use MQTT over TLS (port 8883) and require authentication.

snmp-enabled.title: SNMP enabled on port {{port}}
snmp-enabled.description: SNMP can expose information about the device; no community was tried.
snmp-enabled.recommendation: Disable SNMP if not needed; otherwise use SNMPv3 with authentication.

dns-open-resolver.title: Recursive DNS server on port {{port}}
dns-open-resolver.description: A device other than the router resolves names for anyone who asks: it can be misused.
dns-open-resolver.recommendation: Check whether the DNS service is intended; disable it if not needed.

device-unknown.title: Unidentified device
device-unknown.description: It was not possible to tell what kind of device this is.
device-unknown.recommendation: Check what it is and set its category in the devices page; if you do not recognize it, consider changing the Wi-Fi password.

cve-version-match.title: {{cve}} in {{product}} {{version}}
cve-version-match.description: The version declared by the service falls within a known vulnerability.
cve-version-match.recommendation: Update the device firmware or software to the latest available version; if there is no update, restrict access to the service.

cve-product-only.title: Known vulnerabilities for {{product}} (version not determined)
cve-product-only.description: There are {{cves}} known vulnerabilities for this product, but its version is unknown: it is not possible to tell whether the device is affected.
cve-product-only.recommendation: Check the installed version in the device settings and update it if needed.

people.title: People
people.privacyNote: Automatic associations are only probable: confirm or remove them. A removed association is not proposed again. No location, presence times or traffic are stored. Before using them on employees or other people, inform them (GDPR) and, at work, check the rules on remote monitoring of workers.
